title: Ryot PackRatz Medium Carbon Series
description:
Ryot PackRatz Medium
The new and improved PackRatz carbon series pillow case design is perfect for storing your larger devices like the mighty vaporizer. This vape case is medium but is surprising large and is not something that will fit in your usual pocket. That is unless your day job is in the circus wearing clown pants.
The SmellSafe Carbon Series incorporates extensive carbon fiber padding that both neutralizes and traps odors in its pores while their coated weather-proof fabric and moisture seal zipper provide a true physical barrier to keep odors in and the weather out. To re-activate the carbon lining filters, simply put in the dryer for 5 minutes.
Dimensions
Length – 17.7cm
Width – 12.7cm
Included
1 x Medium PackRatz
1 x Removable Pouch
